desc:
Welcome to Subterra ⛏️! 
It's a 2.5 dimensional mining game with a procedurally generated world where you dig deeper, upgrade your pickaxe and survive layers that get more hostile the further you descend.

❓ [ How to Play ]
- Mine ores and upgrade your pickaxe to go even deeper.
- Build your character with Ability Cards.
- Craft Weapons that help you defeat monsters.
- Obtain rare recipes of weapons and potions.
- Explore various layers.
- Defeat Monsters and Bosses!

💻 [ Controls ]
- E to open Inventory
- C to Interact
- F to Block/Parry
- Left Mouse to Mine

💾 [BETA] 
The game is still under development, expect various changes. 
If you find bugs or have suggestions let us know in the community server!

Thank you for playing!
